cards.flavor_text: The forest crowns only its own.

cards.name: Rootweave Mystic
cards.flavor_text: Roots answer before the question is asked.

cards.name: Starfall Huntress
cards.flavor_text: She reads the wind like scripture.

cards.name: Thornpath Guide
cards.flavor_text: The path is narrow. The thorns are editorial.

cards.name: Leafsignal
cards.flavor_text: Two flashes mean advance. Three mean the moon agrees.

cards.name: Ley Watcher
cards.flavor_text: The roots tell her who stepped wrong an hour ago.

cards.name: Moonspotter
cards.flavor_text: If she sees you, the night already chose a side.

cards.name: Beastwhisper Liaison
cards.flavor_text: Beasts listen when she forgets to speak softly.

cards.name: Gale String
cards.flavor_text: She tunes the wind until the arrows hum in key.

cards.name: Greensignal
cards.flavor_text: Green smoke means hope. Green fire means hurry.

cards.name: Startrail Tracker
cards.flavor_text: He tracks by starlight and unfinished stories.

cards.name: Mistveil Pathfinder
cards.flavor_text: If you can see the path, you are already late.

cards.name: Longshot Choir Lead
cards.flavor_text: One breath. Many strings.

cards.name: Mossweave Adept
cards.flavor_text: Green stitches hold better than iron ones.

cards.name: Glaive Circlet Rider
cards.flavor_text: The circle closes before the shout finishes.

cards.name: Barkwarden
cards.flavor_text: Bark for armor. Sap for stubbornness.

cards.name: Boughlong Archers
cards.flavor_text: The string remembers every name it has erased.

cards.name: Windgliders
cards.flavor_text: Silk wings over open sky; attitude of a hawk.

cards.name: Greenspire Spears
cards.flavor_text: Green wood. Red results.

cards.name: Leafblade Duelist
cards.flavor_text: One cut. One bow. No encore needed.

cards.name: Leafcrown Archers
cards.flavor_text: From the leaves, every helmet looks like a request.

cards.name: Leyline Keeper
cards.flavor_text: Keeps the line. Also keeps score.

cards.name: Mistfall Owl
cards.flavor_text: Hunts the night mist where river and reed become one sky.

cards.name: Mossweave Druid
cards.flavor_text: Speaks tree. Trees speak back louder.

cards.name: Nightstem Stalker
cards.flavor_text: Hides in silver. Strikes in certainty.

cards.name: Startrail Hunter
cards.flavor_text: Hunts by constellation and coincidence.

cards.name: Starwing Falcon
cards.flavor_text: A comma in the sky that ends sentences.

cards.name: Thornbite Scout
cards.flavor_text: Reports back. Usually with someone else’s blood.

cards.name: Thornspike Trapline
cards.flavor_text: The ground looks friendly. It is lying.

cards.name: Thornwall Sentinel
cards.flavor_text: A wall that grew a pulse and a grudge.

cards.name: Treant Sapling
cards.flavor_text: Small tree. Large future problems.

cards.name: Whisperleaf Skirmisher
cards.flavor_text: Steps softer than second thoughts.

cards.name: Zephyr Runner
cards.flavor_text: Arrives before the warning finishes forming.

cards.name: Constellation Greatbow
cards.flavor_text: When stars align, walls reconsider.

cards.name: Grove Wolf Pack
cards.flavor_text: They do not howl for fun. They howl for lunch.

cards.name: Hawk of Starfall
cards.flavor_text: Rider and hawk share one appetite for height.

cards.name: Living Briar Patch
cards.flavor_text: Do not sit. Do not stand. Do not exist nearby.

cards.name: Lunashade
cards.flavor_text: A silhouette that learned to bite.

cards.name: Quietbranch Sniper
cards.flavor_text: You will not hear the shot. The forest will.

cards.name: Rootbound Ent
cards.flavor_text: Older than your kingdom. Less patient.

cards.name: Silverstep Dancer
cards.flavor_text: Dance first. Then explain the blood.

cards.name: Thornheart Stag
cards.flavor_text: Charges like a sermon with antlers.

cards.name: Thornspire Unicorn
cards.flavor_text: Horn first. Questions never.

cards.name: Windbow Circle
cards.flavor_text: They shoot as a single breath of wind.

cards.name: Windcaller
cards.flavor_text: She asks the air to misbehave. It obliges.

cards.name: Dryad Circle
cards.flavor_text: They heal the grove and bill the invaders.

cards.name: Elder Treant
cards.flavor_text: Slow to anger. Impossible to hurry.

cards.name: Fallen Star Ancient
cards.flavor_text: Fell once from the sky. Liked it here.

cards.name: Featherblade
cards.flavor_text: Steel and pinion in the same argument.

cards.name: Spiritbow of Moonfall
cards.flavor_text: Arrows woven from moonlight and grudges.

cards.name: Wild Hunt Riders
cards.flavor_text: The forest goes riding. Bring a will.

cards.name: Briar Skirmish Line
cards.flavor_text: A living hedge with a spear hobby.

cards.name: Tidehawk
cards.flavor_text: A prayer with talons, riding the wind above the water.

cards.name: Thornclaw Sabertooth
cards.flavor_text: Beauty, fangs, and zero interest in diplomacy.

cards.name: Galewood Wisps
cards.flavor_text: Pretty lights. Terrible decisions.

cards.name: Sapling Drill
cards.flavor_text: Teaches roots before blades.

cards.name: Thorn Link
cards.flavor_text: A hedge of friends is still a hedge.

cards.name: Leafsignal Runner
cards.flavor_text: Whispers pace to the undergrowth.

cards.name: Bow Pair Tutor
cards.flavor_text: Two strings, one aim.

cards.name: Grove Sergeant
cards.flavor_text: The grove bends around the weak.

cards.name: Trail Warden
cards.flavor_text: Never outruns the saplings.

cards.name: Hearthstone Covenant
cards.flavor_text: The hearth does not flicker while she stands.

cards.name: Realmward High Marshal
cards.flavor_text: One banner. Every hearth answers.

cards.name: Thunderhoof Caller
cards.flavor_text: Dust rises before the herd is seen.

cards.name: Iron Covenant Spear
cards.flavor_text: Every shield remembers the same oath.

cards.name: Quartermaster Vale
cards.flavor_text: Quarters, rations, and who sleeps with a spear.

cards.name: Cadence Drillmaster
cards.flavor_text: Left, left, left-right-left — until fear marches too.

cards.name: Pike Row Instructor
cards.flavor_text: Elbows in. Points out. Prayers optional.

cards.name: Shieldkin Tutor
cards.flavor_text: Raise the shield like you mean to keep your face.

cards.name: Column Cartographer
cards.flavor_text: He draws the map in chalk and certainty.

cards.name: Tuskline Handler
cards.flavor_text: If the tusks turn, everyone turns. No debate.

cards.name: Cohort Standard
cards.flavor_text: The pole is oak. The oath is iron.

cards.name: Flamebanner Bearer
cards.flavor_text: As long as the banner burns, the line does not break.

cards.name: Siege Hauler Merek
cards.flavor_text: Wheels first. Glory later.

cards.name: Pavise Wall Captain
cards.flavor_text: The wall walks. You hide behind it.

cards.name: Outrider Marshal Kade
cards.flavor_text: Dust on the horizon is already an order.

cards.name: Field Chirurgeon Wren
cards.flavor_text: Stitch the line before you scold it.

cards.name: Boltstorm Company
cards.flavor_text: A conversation in bolt-form.

cards.name: Dusttrail Scouts
cards.flavor_text: Where the road ends, they keep riding.

cards.name: Fencepost Pikes
cards.flavor_text: The classic: long stick, short conversation.

cards.name: Grand Tusker
cards.flavor_text: War, but bigger and smellier.

cards.name: Keepguard
cards.flavor_text: The pass belongs to whoever can hold it.

cards.name: Keystone Guard
cards.flavor_text: Stone holds. So do we.

cards.name: Lockstep Cohort
cards.flavor_text: A shield wall is only as strong as the ground beneath it.

cards.name: Marchland Outriders
cards.flavor_text: Scout, courier, and occasional hurricane.

cards.name: Market Slingers
cards.flavor_text: Pebbles with patriotism.

cards.name: Oathbill Halberdiers
cards.flavor_text: Axe, hook, and a firm opinion about cavalry.

cards.name: Parish Levy
cards.flavor_text: Farmers yesterday. Heroes by lunch.

cards.name: Quarryside Crossbows
cards.flavor_text: They learned to shoot where the cliffs give no room to advance.

cards.name: Redpike Line
cards.flavor_text: The trees hide the pikes until it is too late.

cards.name: Shieldkin
cards.flavor_text: Born under a shield. Raised under orders.

cards.name: Spur Lancers
cards.flavor_text: Iron manners. Soft landing optional.

cards.name: Stockyard Tusker
cards.flavor_text: Friendly until stepped on. Then geology.

cards.name: Votive Lancers
cards.flavor_text: Pointed diplomacy on four legs.

cards.name: Warmarch Longbows
cards.flavor_text: Keeps the home fires… over there.

cards.name: Ridgebreaker
cards.flavor_text: If the enemy takes the ridge, break the ridge.

cards.name: Column Veterans
cards.flavor_text: Has seen worse. Will make you see it too.

cards.name: Firstfire Vanguard
cards.flavor_text: First through the door. Last to apologize.

cards.name: Gatebrace Line
cards.flavor_text: Every mountain pass has a gate. Sometimes the gate is us.

cards.name: Homeguard Ballista
cards.flavor_text: The fortress begins where the road turns upward.

cards.name: Briarbound Hounds
cards.flavor_text: They follow trails no horse could find.

cards.name: Platebreakers
cards.flavor_text: Breaks lines the way winters break rivers.

cards.name: Riverwind Rider
cards.flavor_text: The river is only another road beneath their wings.

cards.name: Siege Mammoth
cards.flavor_text: Siege engine that breathes and sulks.

cards.name: Siege Psalm
cards.flavor_text: Throws rocks. Also throws policy.

cards.name: Skypike Lancers
cards.flavor_text: Lances from above. Gravity helps.

cards.name: Brushmastiffs
cards.flavor_text: The first sign of the pack is usually the last.

cards.name: Anvil Champion
cards.flavor_text: Every hammer needs an anvil. Every army needs a mountain.

cards.name: Bastion Wardens
cards.flavor_text: Let them climb. We will still be here when they arrive.

cards.name: Cinderlance Cohort
cards.flavor_text: The ground burns. Their lances burn hotter.

cards.name: Cleaving Oathsworn
cards.flavor_text: One blade. Several opinions. All loud.

cards.name: Hearthfall Colossus
cards.flavor_text: When the earth shakes, the enemy learns to pray.

cards.name: Ordnance Culverin
cards.flavor_text: Doctrine delivered at high velocity.

cards.name: Gearworks Engine
cards.flavor_text: Gears, oaths, and a very large crank.

cards.name: Oathstandard
cards.flavor_text: Where it plants, courage files paperwork.

cards.name: Tollgate Longspears
cards.flavor_text: A polite way to keep the world at arm’s length.

cards.name: Aegis Skybreaker
cards.flavor_text: When the sky needs breaking, call covenant.

cards.name: Drill Cadet
cards.flavor_text: Counts steps until the line stops wobbling.

cards.name: Buckler Link
cards.flavor_text: Two shields are a wall. One is a prayer.

cards.name: Drum Corporal
cards.flavor_text: The beat is orders you can hear.

cards.name: Lance Pair Leader
cards.flavor_text: Points at the same hole. Every time.

cards.name: Sergeant-at-Arms
cards.flavor_text: Keeps the cheap seats alive.

cards.name: Column Guide
cards.flavor_text: Walks slow so the line can keep up.

cards.name: Scalefen Summit
cards.flavor_text: The fen claims all who wade without respect.

cards.name: Fenbrood Scale-King
cards.flavor_text: The clutch hears only the king's drum.

cards.name: Hydra Broodmother
cards.flavor_text: Cut one head and two more drink the rain.

cards.name: Gorgon Basalt Matriarch
cards.flavor_text: Stone is merely flesh that forgot to blink.

cards.name: Fen Guide
cards.flavor_text: Wade where he wades. The fen forgives him.

cards.name: Brood Liaison
cards.flavor_text: He negotiates with nests. The nests negotiate back.

cards.name: Mud Handler
cards.flavor_text: He speaks crocodile. The crocs pretend not to.

cards.name: Silt Watcher
cards.flavor_text: If the mud bubbles, do not ask why. Move.

cards.name: Arena Handler
cards.flavor_text: The pit is deep. His patience is deeper.

cards.name: Marshstone Guide
cards.flavor_text: Stone that grew up in water still remembers teeth.

cards.name: Brood Watcher
cards.flavor_text: Count the heads. Then count again. Then run.

cards.name: Coil Handler
cards.flavor_text: Coil once for warning. Twice for supper.

cards.name: Reeddrift Scout Lead
cards.flavor_text: The reed parts. So does the line.

cards.name: Venom Coil Overseer
cards.flavor_text: A drop in the water is an argument settled.

cards.name: Broodbeast Driver
cards.flavor_text: If it hisses, it is ready. If it does not, poke harder.

cards.name: Shellback Warden
cards.flavor_text: The marsh keeps what the shell claims.

cards.name: Arena Croc
cards.flavor_text: Arena rules: there are no arena rules.

cards.name: Reed Javelins
cards.flavor_text: Thrown from the reedline before the water even ripples.

cards.name: Camo Ambusher
cards.flavor_text: Was a bush. Became a problem.

cards.name: Coil Serpent
cards.flavor_text: A rope that decided to have hobbies.

cards.name: Dart Skink
cards.flavor_text: Small, swift, and socially unimpressed.

cards.name: Fang Slinger
cards.flavor_text: Pebbles dipped in bad ideas.

cards.name: Fang Stalker
cards.flavor_text: Venom with a calendar and a plan.

cards.name: Fenbow Hunter
cards.flavor_text: Hunts from the reed line. Collects rumors.

cards.name: Gorgon Acolyte
cards.flavor_text: Still practicing the stare. Already effective.

cards.name: Hydra Hatchling
cards.flavor_text: Cute. Temporary. Multiplying.

cards.name: Stone Guard
cards.flavor_text: Hard as rock. Soft on nothing.

cards.name: Marsh Spears
cards.flavor_text: Simple tool. Complicated aftermath.

cards.name: Mire Lurker
cards.flavor_text: Half submerged. Fully committed.

cards.name: Pathcroc
cards.flavor_text: The path is the croc. Watch your ankles.

cards.name: Reed Scout
cards.flavor_text: Maps the mud. Mud maps the scouts.

cards.name: Scale Brute
cards.flavor_text: Subtlety is for thinner lizards.

cards.name: Stonegaze Gorgon
cards.flavor_text: Look away. Then look away harder.

cards.name: Stonejaw Crusher
cards.flavor_text: Turns terrain into punctuation.

cards.name: Coil Priest
cards.flavor_text: Prays in stone. Answers in venom.

cards.name: Gorgon Eye
cards.flavor_text: One eye. Many regrets.

cards.name: Hydra Spawn
cards.flavor_text: Sibling rivalry with cleaving.

cards.name: Mountain Pillar
cards.flavor_text: A wall that grew a badge and a glare.

cards.name: Marsh Naga
cards.flavor_text: Poisoned courtesy with excellent reach.

cards.name: Mire Beast
cards.flavor_text: Mud with a pulse and a diet plan.

cards.name: Mudbrace Line
cards.flavor_text: Shields slick with swamp and resolve.

cards.name: River Titan
cards.flavor_text: When the river stands up, evacuate.

cards.name: Swamp Hydra
cards.flavor_text: The swamp’s way of saying “enough.”

cards.name: Tide Ripper
cards.flavor_text: Rip first. Ask the current later.

cards.name: Venom Spitter
cards.flavor_text: Range is a courtesy. Poison is the point.

cards.name: Viper Brood
cards.flavor_text: A nest that learned teamwork.

cards.name: Chameleon Warden
cards.flavor_text: Present. Absent. Suddenly teeth.

cards.name: Deathroll
cards.flavor_text: A hug that rewrites anatomy.

cards.name: Fen Basilisk
cards.flavor_text: Stare contest champion. Undefeated.

cards.name: Riverstone Hydra Brood
cards.flavor_text: Family reunion with extra necks.

cards.name: Temple Scale Guard
cards.flavor_text: Guards the temple. Taxes the unworthy.

cards.name: Viperfang Hydra
cards.flavor_text: Heads for every flavor of misfortune.

cards.name: Muck Stalker
cards.flavor_text: Leaves no footprints. Leaves plenty of panic.

cards.name: Swamp Matriarch
cards.flavor_text: Mother of stares. Queen of quiet dread.

cards.name: Worldcoil Serpent
cards.flavor_text: The horizon that bites back.

cards.name: Spawning Pool
cards.flavor_text: Where deep water writes new arguments.

cards.name: Hatchling Drill
cards.flavor_text: Snaps jaws in unison.

cards.name: Scale Link
cards.flavor_text: Overlap scales. Survive the first bite.

cards.name: Reed Horn Skink
cards.flavor_text: The marsh moves when it calls.

cards.name: Fang Pair Boss
cards.flavor_text: Strike the same vein twice.

cards.name: Brood Sergeant
cards.flavor_text: Broodlings behind him live longer.

cards.name: Shoal Pacekeeper
cards.flavor_text: Never leaves the shoals behind.

cards.name: Mantlet Crew
cards.flavor_text: Shields on wheels; courage optional.

cards.name: Field Ballista
cards.flavor_text: Bolt racks stamped for whoever pays the crew.

cards.name: Ironhead Ram
cards.flavor_text: A door's least favorite relative.

cards.name: Timber Catapult
cards.flavor_text: Counterweight patience, then sudden arithmetic.

cards.name: Long-Arm Trebuchet
cards.flavor_text: The arm that makes walls reconsider their careers.

cards.name: Rolling Siege Tower
cards.flavor_text: Stairs with an agenda.

cards.name: Gravemind Orth
cards.flavor_text: Death is a revolving door.

cards.name: Eclipse Lich Vesper
cards.flavor_text: Light fails on schedule.

cards.name: Lord of the Still Host
cards.flavor_text: The dead march for their own.

cards.name: Bone Harvester Mire
cards.flavor_text: Fortifications are just future skeletons.

cards.name: Wight Captain Rasp
cards.flavor_text: Orders that outlive the voice.

cards.name: Crypt Engineer Bone
cards.flavor_text: Catapults assembled from leftovers.

cards.name: Fear Herald Hush
cards.flavor_text: Whispers with teeth.

cards.name: Necromancer Quill
cards.flavor_text: Once per battle is enough.

cards.name: Thrall Driver Lash
cards.flavor_text: The whip is ceremonial. The fear is not.

cards.name: Death Knight Lead
cards.flavor_text: Armor older than nations.

cards.name: Soul Tither Coin
cards.flavor_text: Every fall pays the company.

cards.name: Tomb Guard Officer
cards.flavor_text: The tomb still has a duty roster.

cards.name: Dirge Herald Vellum
cards.flavor_text: The song has no living audience left.

cards.name: Ossuary Binder
cards.flavor_text: Bones are just unfinished orders.

cards.name: Catapult Wight Lead
cards.flavor_text: Dead hands do not tire on the ropes.

cards.name: Barrow Blade Captain
cards.flavor_text: The barrow door opens outward only.

cards.name: Ash Thralls
cards.flavor_text: Burned once. Still warm enough to march.

cards.name: Bone Archers
cards.flavor_text: Empty quivers, emptier eyes.

cards.name: Bone Dogs
cards.flavor_text: Loyal past death—and still sniffing the game trails.

cards.name: Chained Dead
cards.flavor_text: Links longer than lives.

cards.name: Crypt Rats
cards.flavor_text: Squeaks in the walls.

cards.name: Grave Diggers
cards.flavor_text: Always hiring.

cards.name: Pale Militia
cards.flavor_text: Muster from memory across the open field.

cards.name: Shambling Spears
cards.flavor_text: Points without purpose.

cards.name: Skeleton Levy
cards.flavor_text: Brittle, back again.

cards.name: Skull Slingers
cards.flavor_text: Recycling policy.

cards.name: Whisper Choir
cards.flavor_text: Harmonized dread between the trunks.

cards.name: Zombie Horde
cards.flavor_text: Slow meat.

cards.name: Banshee Screams
cards.flavor_text: Paid in advance with someone else's life.

cards.flavor_text: Paid in advance with someone else's life.

cards.flavor_text: Interlock ribs beneath the roots. Pretend the forest notices.

cards.flavor_text: The dead march when it moans.

cards.flavor_text: Two shoves, one coffin lid.

cards.flavor_text: Cheap bones last longer in a pile.
